visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a thick tree trunk with deeply textured, scaly brown bark. A dark-skinned hand enters the frame and begins tapping the bark repeatedly. (2) As the hand rubs the surface of the bark, dozens of tiny black ants emerge from the crevices and begin scurrying over the skin of the hand. (3) The camera pulls back slightly to show a man's forearm, revealing he is wearing a black t-shirt and camouflage trousers. He allows the ants to crawl up his arm while standing in a dense green forest. (4) The man rubs his hands together vigorously, crushing the ants, and then smears his arms as if applying a lotion. The surrounding environment consists of lush tropical foliage and a leaf-covered forest floor.
